about: The six Coco themes: ONE source for desktop, phone (PWA) and Android. Edit seeds here, run `node contract/build-themes.mjs` (needs the dev dependency @material/material-color-utilities) to regenerate theme-schemes.json, then `node contract/build.mjs`. Theme 1 is LOCKED: its five brand values below are asserted by theme-schemes.test.js and must never change.

themes.name: Original Signature
themes.tagline: Black, hot pink and bright yellow on deep aubergine and soft lavender. The founders' own.
themes.notes: Black for cards and navigation, hot pink for selected states and important accents, bright yellow for highlights and calls to action.

themes.name: Electric Cobalt
themes.tagline: A vibrant blue technology theme with aqua and amber accents.

themes.name: Royal Violet
themes.tagline: A premium, expressive purple with cyan and rose accents.

themes.name: Emerald Energy
themes.tagline: A fresh, modern green business theme with lime and sky accents.

themes.name: Tangerine Fusion
themes.tagline: A bold orange and blue combination with an energetic personality.

themes.name: Digital Orchid
themes.tagline: A colourful, sophisticated, futuristic theme with mint and gold.
